residency.rule: At least 30 of the minimum 60 degree credits must be completed at Richard Bland College.

last_hours_residency.reason: The reviewed current catalog and current institutional policy page do not repeat the historical nine-of-the-last-fifteen rule; do not carry it forward without current Registrar confirmation.

modeling_notes: This is one combined Mathematics/Computer Science transfer award. The official program index supplies the combined scope and CIP 30.0801 and does not list a standalone Computer Science A.S.
For the Computer Science branch, the additional seven-credit quantitative rule is CSCI 222 AND one of MATH 254, MATH 261, or MATH 271; it is not a flat choose-one menu.
The 15-16 elective block contains recommendations tied to the transfer destination. Recommended mathematics and natural-science courses are not additional AND requirements.
Richard Bland is outside VCCS and uses institution-local CSCI/MATH course codes; resolve them only in the Richard Bland course namespace.

data_quality_flags.message: Expose the award as Math/Computer Science A.S.; do not relabel it as a standalone Computer Science A.S.
RBC course codes must not join the VCCS course registry solely by normalized code.
The current Acalog host has no TLS listener, so program/catalog sources are official but not secure.
